use_cases: Displaying animated loading indicators with spinning text
Creating decorative circular text layouts for branding elements
Building eye-catching hero section typography with rotating messages
Adding visual interest to call-to-action buttons with animated text
Implementing creative logo treatments with revolving text
ai_summary: A motion-primitives component that renders text arranged in a circular pattern and continuously rotates it. Uses Framer Motion for smooth animation with configurable duration, radius, and direction. The text characters are positioned using CSS custom properties and transforms to create a circular layout. Ideal for creating engaging loading states, decorative text elements, or attention-grabbing hero typography.
